disposition.target: RWB-P4-E1037-CON (rwb-access authorise contract) and the gateway-bff session record
disposition.change: Resolve the role set, the scope with the team and region codes and the two version labels on every authorise call and return them; the edge keeps them on its session record in the gateway-bff Redis store until the session ends, cleared by the access event; the ROLE_CONFLICT refusal fact raises the incident to the security administrator queue.
disposition.note: Session home, conflict incident and region read sit in the rwb-access contract and the gateway-bff session; section 3 already bars caching role data beyond one call; no roles-and-teams path may be invented here.
AC7 in section 7 and TC-P3-E1019-CON-07 in section 16 cover BR2, BR3, BR6; section 8 maps BR1, BR4, BR5, BR7, BR8 to AC1, AC3, AC4, AC6 with test rows, so every rule has a criterion and a test.
